english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for events or actions occurring at the same time.
Use this when “whilst” means “meanwhile” or emphasizes that two things happen at the same time.

examples.traditional: 我哋同時收到兩份通知。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 tung4 si4 sau1 dou2 loeng5 fan6 tung1 zi1

examples.english: I listened to the radio whilst cooking dinner.
examples.traditional: 我一邊煮飯，同時聽住收音機。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 bin1 zyu2 faan6 tung4 si4 ting1 zyu6 sau1 jam1 gei1
